prompt.zh-TW: 晴川花坊替一場婚禮布置會場，價值 {{money:vars.order}}，新人說下個月才付款。花坊這個月的損益表上，這筆生意怎麼呈現？
prompt.en: Clearwater Florist decorates a wedding venue for {{money:vars.order}}, and the couple will pay next month. How does this job appear on the florist’s income statement for this month?

text.zh-TW: 營業收入這個月就增加 {{money:vars.order}}，因為服務已經完成
text.en: Revenue rises by {{money:vars.order}} this month, because the service has been delivered

feedback.zh-TW: 答對了。花坊已經把該做的做完，收入就算賺到了，什麼時候收錢是另一件事。
feedback.en: Nice work. The florist has done what it promised, so the revenue is earned; when the cash arrives is a separate matter.

text.zh-TW: 這個月沒有收入，要等收到錢那個月才算
text.en: No revenue this month; it counts in the month the cash arrives

feedback.zh-TW: 你把「收到錢」當成認列的時點，這是現金的想法。損益表用權責發生制：服務完成的那個月就要認列收入。
feedback.en: You used the arrival of cash as the trigger, which is the cash way of thinking. The income statement uses the accrual basis: revenue is recognised in the month the service is completed.

text.zh-TW: 這筆生意在收到錢之前不會影響任何報表
text.en: The job does not affect any statement until the cash is received

feedback.zh-TW: 其實已經影響兩張表了：損益表的收入增加，資產負債表的應收帳款也增加。
feedback.en: It already affects two statements: revenue on the income statement rises, and so do trade receivables on the balance sheet.

explanation.zh-TW: 權責發生制的規則是：收入在賺到的時候認列。會場布置完成，收入就賺到了，所以{{option:o_ee8q}}正確。還沒收到的錢，暫時放在資產負債表的應收帳款。
explanation.en: Under the accrual basis, revenue is recognised when it is earned. The venue is decorated, so the revenue is earned and {{option:o_ee8q}} is right. The money not yet received sits in trade receivables on the balance sheet for now.
